title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF contributed with MoE to strengthen the capacity of education actors in Venezuela by training 129,184 teachers across various levels and modalities, as well as staff from Educational Quality Development Centers (CDCE). They supported the implementation of programs within the framework of Child-Friendly Schools.
